summary_en: Nozawa authorized acquisition of up to 150,000 shares (1.3% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 240.45 million yen through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over a one-year period from November 16, 2026 to November 15, 2027, to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business and market conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Nozawa Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 150,000 shares of common stock, representing 1.3% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of 240.45 million yen. The company will conduct the acquisition through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading arrangement from November 16, 2026 through November 15, 2027.

The acquisition is intended to enable the company to implement flexible capital policies in response to changes in business and market conditions. The board resolution was passed pursuant to Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied through Article 165(3). Actual acquisition may be partially or entirely suspended depending on market conditions. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 165,448 treasury shares against 11,909,552 shares outstanding.
